topiary_mirror: We look great. Obviously. One of us is a bush.
Strike a pose. No, the other one. Hedge, you're doing it wrong.
ice_lick: It is cold. Nobody warned me. Everybody warned me.
My tongue is part of the art now. Don't touch it.
sand_flag: I claim this castle in the name of me.
Flag's up. Kingdom of Cheese. Population: one damp duck.
sand_stomp: RAWR. Property values just went down.
Built it. Wrecked it. Character development.
gong_bong: BONG. That's for everyone who ever doubted me.
Did the whole pond hear that? Good.
gong_dinner: Dinner! There is no dinner. Come anyway.
Three bongs means company. Four means I got bored.
gong_ears: Too loud! Who did that? ...Oh. Me.
My ears are ringing in B flat.
aurora_on: Lights on. Sky's getting a promotion.
Ooh. Fancy. I paid for this, so it counts.
aurora_watch: Shh. The sky's doing the thing.
I'm not crying, the lights are just very green.
rainbow_make: I made a rainbow. Put that on my resume.
Science. Mist. Crank. Beauty. You're welcome.
rainbow_compare: Real rainbow's bigger. Mine has better attitude.
weather_cloud: Tiny cloud, just for me. Finally, weather that listens.
I am now in charge of the forecast. Panic.
weather_zap: OW. Shit. Okay. Zero stars, would touch again.
My feathers are standing up and so is my opinion of this machine.
portal_peek: Saw another me in there. He looked smug.
wormhole_whisper: I told it a secret. It told me the same secret. Traitor.
blackhole_feed: Nom. Do black holes burp? It burped.
Feeding the void. Responsible pet ownership.
blackhole_gauge: Gauge says 'fine'. Gauge has said that about everything.
Horizon: holding. Me: also holding. Barely.
blackhole_stare: I stared into the void. The void blinked first.
Nothing in there. Just like my calendar.
volcano_fizz: This is the most responsible thing I've done today.
volcano_warm: Warm rocks. Cold duck. Perfect math.
If I sit here long enough I become toast. Worth it.
tornado_pat: Who's a good little disaster? You are.
He likes chin scratches. He has no chin.
tornado_night: Night night, storm. No touring the neighborhood.
Blanket on. Don't eat anyone's roof.
antigrav_float: I'm floating! Don't look at my belly.
Gravity's off. My dignity left too.
field_shelter: Rain can't touch me. I'm basically royalty.
arch_trace: That one's the Big Bread. I named it. It's official.
Connect the dots. The dots are suns. No pressure.
arch_stars: Counting stars. Lost count. Starting over. Again.
Somewhere up there, a duck is counting me.
arch_wish: Wished for something. Not telling. Bad luck.
Okay universe. One wish. Don't screw it up.
time_year: Set it to a year when bread was free.
Back in my day... wait, which day.
time_trip: I went to the past. It smelled like pond. Very authentic.
Back already? Nobody even missed me. Cool. Cool cool.
booth_inside: Ballroom. In a box. I need to sit down.
dimdoor_peek: Wrong door. Whole wrong universe. Closing it.
Is that an eye? That's an eye. Bye.
dimdoor_knock: Knocked on the back. Something knocked back. Great.
Checking the other side. Ugh. More door.
teleport_wait: Nothing's happening and I'm very brave about it.
robot_morning: Morning, Clanky. Beep at me if you love me.
He waved! Nobody tell him I cried.
robot_bow: Bow like this. Elegant. Like me.
Good bow. Too much bow. Get up. Okay.
clone_meet: Hi me. You're shorter in person.
Two of us. The pond isn't ready.
transmog_result: Put in a leaf, got a rubber duck. Fair trade.
Science said: sock. Science is drunk.
transmog_kick: Percussive maintenance. Worked. I'm a genius.
Kicked it. It fixed itself out of fear.
printer_bucks: Duck Bucks. Not real money. Don't tell the bank.
I'm rich in a currency nobody accepts.
printer_jam: Give it back, you rolling bastard.
printer_rain: Make it rain! It's play money. Still feels great.
This is how billionaires feel. Hollow. Fluttery.
perpetual_stop: Hnng. It won. It always wins.
Stopping it is impossible. Like me before breakfast.
perpetual_count: I lost count. It didn't notice. Rude.
dna_result: Printout says I'm related to a toaster. Explains a lot.
shrink_zap: Shrunk it. Don't point this at my bread.
growth_zap: BIG DANDELION. I've made a terrible beautiful mistake.
That flower is now my landlord.
genie_smoke: Rubbed the lamp. Lamp rubbed back emotionally.
genie_wish: Wishing for... no. Bigger. No. Bread. Fine, bread.
One wish down. Spending them wisely. Mostly.
genie_peek: It's dark and it smells like old wishes.
cloak_boo: BOO. You didn't see me. Nobody ever sees me.
Invisible duck. Very dangerous. Very cute.
dream_feather: One of my feathers. For the good dreams.
Now it's got a bit of me in it. Lucky dreams.
dream_release: Last night's dreams. Go on, scram.
Shook out a dream about bread. Classic.
dragon_brood: Shh. I'm a duck. This is literally my job.
Warm egg. Warm heart. Hot butt.
dragon_listen: Something moved in there. Something with opinions.
It tapped back. We're friends now. Or it's hungry.
dragon_lullaby: La la. Sleep, little scary friend.
Hush little dragon, don't burn the pond.
